A target given by its characteristic function

Source: R/cf_target.R
cf_target.Rd

Builds a gmm_target that carries only a characteristic function \(\varphi(t) = E \exp(i t^\top X)\). fit_proxymix() fits such a target with regime "cf", which calls from_cf().

Usage

cf_target(cf, n_dim, name = "cf_target", metadata = list())

Arguments

cf

A function that takes an n by n_dim matrix of frequencies, one per row, and returns the characteristic function at each row as a complex vector of length n, as in from_cf().

n_dim

Dimension of the target.

name

Human-readable name.

metadata

Optional list of additional descriptors.

Value

A gmm_target with cf set and no log_density or samples.

Details

The function is checked before the target is built: it must return one finite value for each row of its argument, equal 1 at zero, have modulus at most 1, satisfy \(\varphi(-t) = \overline{\varphi(t)}\), and fall to one half along each coordinate axis between frequencies 1e-4 and 1e4. The checks use random frequencies, and the state of the random number generator is left unchanged.

See also

fit_proxymix(), from_cf(), from_cf_elliptical(), from_cf_sources(), gmm_cf_distance().

Other targets: banana_target(), donut_target(), epanechnikov_target(), gmm_target_from_samples(), maxent_target(), mixture_target()

Examples

## The sum of a Gamma(3) variable and independent N(0, 0.25) noise.
tgt <- cf_target(
  function(t) (1 - 1i * t[, 1])^(-3) * exp(-0.125 * t[, 1]^2),
  n_dim = 1L
)
tgt
#> <gmm_target>: "cf_target" in p = 1 dimensions
#>   log_density : <absent>
#>   samples     : <absent>
#>   cf          : supplied
#>   normalised  : unknown
fit <- fit_proxymix(tgt, N = 3L, n_freq = 1024L, seed = 1L)
#> Auto-selected regime: "cf".
gmm_fit_quality(fit)$cf_upper
#> [1] 0.00859195
